description: The real N14 run: eight new arms (r10, r20, r40; sub10, sub05, sub025, sub0125; sub20-rw) on N12's five seeds (4101-4105), 40 training runs, plus re-measurement of N12's saved sub20 and n80-mix (read from the n12_bottleneck Drive folder), measured on the held-out tail's windows 1-512. Calibration done (seed 3001; amendment A1 added the sub0125 rung). NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 90 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
